video_title: The Brunson REINVENTION, KAT's Evolution, and What Happens with MSG Ticket Prices?!

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the Knicks' potential to build a statue for Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: He wins a title in New York, he's definitely getting a statue, bro.
quotes.quote: I want a title in Boston. I'm probably not going to get a statue. He wins a title in New York, he's definitely getting a statue, bro.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the lack of success for Kyrie Irving-led teams
quotes.excerpt: I've never seen a Kyrie-led team win a title.
quotes.quote: I've never seen a Kyrie-led team win a title.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the Spurs' youth and lack of experience in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: For the first time in all the playoffs, I feel like their youth is starting to show.

text_blocks.speaker: Paul Pierce
text_blocks.text: For the first time in all the playoffs, I feel like their youth is starting to show. Costly turnovers, bad possessions, not being on the same page. A lot of little things that you didn't see throughout the playoffs from the Spurs because, to be honest with you, watching them throughout the Western Conference, they look like a seasoned veteran team.

text_blocks.speaker: Danny Green
text_blocks.text: Is this Spurs' young age starting to show? And how bad was that last sequence?

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the difficulty of coming back from an 0-2 deficit
quotes.excerpt: I don't know if there's any team in history that's come back from an 0-2 deficit.
quotes.quote: I don't know if there's any team in history that's come back from an 0-2 deficit. I would bet my life on it, maybe one team ever done it or zero teams.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on Karl-Anthony Towns' development as a playmaker
quotes.excerpt: I love what he's morphed into since the playoffs started in Atlanta.
quotes.quote: I wasn't a big fan of KAT in Minnesota, but I love what he's morphed into since the playoffs started in Atlanta. He was always a good talent to me, but I thought there was something missing from his game to where you could win it all with a player like him. And when he started becoming this guy who became a better passer, I was like, hold on, this is an element I haven't seen from KAT.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the lack of competition in the Eastern Conference
quotes.excerpt: In the Eastern Conference, you can get to the conference finals with playing very mid teams.

text_blocks.speaker: Draymond Green
text_blocks.text: In the Eastern Conference, you can get to the conference finals with playing very mid teams. And so that's kind of what y'all are doing right now. And I think what this is setting up for y'all is what happened to the Atlanta Hawks three years ago when they made the conference finals and they never got back.

text_blocks.speaker: Paul Pierce
text_blocks.text: I'm a Knicks hater, and I'm not ashamed to admit it. I hate the Knicks.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the Knicks' potential to be an all-time great team
quotes.excerpt: Unless they got three players on this team that become Hall of Famers, I'm not putting them in that category.
quotes.quote: Unless they got three players on this team that become Hall of Famers, I'm not putting them in that category. No. Like, all right, Brunson, he's trajecting toward Hall of Fame now, currently. KAT is trajecting toward Hall of Fame. Who else? When you talk about all-time great teams, they got at least three Hall of Famers on there. And I'm sorry, they're not in that group.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce's prediction for Game 3 of the Spurs-Knicks series
quotes.excerpt: I got San Antonio winning. I don't know when the last time they lost three in a row.
quotes.quote: I got San Antonio winning. I don't know when the last time they lost three in a row. I saw a stat they haven't lost three in a row. I don't know if they've lost three in a row this year. I can't think, but I don't think they'll lose the first game. I think they'll come back more locked in.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the importance of Jalen Brunson's playmaking and defense
quotes.excerpt: He's one of the more well-rounded bigs we have in our league today.
quotes.quote: He's one of the more well-rounded bigs we have in our league today, and it's showing, and that's why the Knicks are up. And like you said, he is probably the favorite to win Finals MVP because he's shooting a high percentage, he's rebounding at a high level, he's passing, and doing all the necessary things that you need from a big guy to help win on both ends of the court.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on Jalen Brunson's status among the league's best guards
quotes.excerpt: Is Jalen Brunson better than Kyrie all-time if he wins?
quotes.quote: Is Jalen Brunson better than Kyrie all-time if he wins? Man, hold on now. I have to agree with that because I've never seen a Kyrie-led team win a title. And as great as Kyrie has been in his career, there's going to be some tough conversations made if or when the Knicks win this title about Jalen Brunson and where he stands in NBA history as one of the better guards.
